title: Does adaptive thermogenesis occur after weight loss in adults? A systematic review (Nunes et al.)
content: Nunes CL et al. — Systematic review examining whether adaptive thermogenesis (a drop in energy expenditure beyond what reduced body mass alone would explain) occurs after weight loss in adults. The review finds adaptive thermogenesis CAN occur, but its magnitude varies considerably across individuals and studies — it is not a fixed, universal, precisely-quantifiable effect.

title: Does adaptive thermogenesis occur after weight loss in adults? A systematic review (Nunes et al.)
content: Nunes et al. — Product implication: an AI coach can acknowledge that a weight-loss plateau MAY partly reflect adaptive thermogenesis, but must NEVER invent a specific number (e.g. 'your metabolism has dropped by exactly 150 kcal/day') without an actual measurement or model backing it for that individual. Where the system has not measured this directly, it should describe adaptive thermogenesis only as context/explanation, never as a precise correction applied to a calorie target.
